scope: isolated local request planning and decoding; no current platform/Subject consumer
change: Plan at most 256 overlapping half-open windows over caller-supplied <=86400-second duration; report unplanned tail. Decode a requested <=600-second window with source PTS preserved and explicit non-observation status.

contract.windows: Each {start_seconds,end_seconds} is a request only; truncated/unplanned_intervals explicitly expose budget exhaustion; caller source and duration remain unverified.
contract.decoder: FFmpeg -copyts, bounded input seek and source-PTS trim; returns container-relative timestamps, original integer PTS/time_base, requested window, and source geometry. Nonzero origin preserved; every returned frame is rechecked inside requested half-open interval.
contract.empty: No newly decoded frame is NO_NEW_FRAME_DECODED_NOT_OBSERVED; does not prove blank/empty visual content. A previous held VFR frame may exist.
contract.bounds: individual window <=600s, max 1200 frames and 64MiB+one RGB frame, <=120s process timeout, source file <=256MiB; container duration is unverified.

controlled_results.vfr_offsets: source PTS at 0/0.5/1.75/2; request [0.6,2.1) returns 1.75/2 with byte-identical frames even when container origin is 5s; [0.6,1.6) returns no new frame and unknown content
controlled_results.boundary: adjacent [0,0.5), [0.5,2.25) union equals full source timestamps, integer PTS and decoded RGB in this fixture
controlled_results.long_synthetic: 601s static 32×32 at 1fps; windows [0,600), [599,601) decoded 600+2 frames, 601 unique source timestamps, overlap 1, no missing expected generated frames
controlled_results.resource_one_run: source 16502 bytes, RGB output 1849344 bytes, wall 0.424s, child CPU 0.440s, max child RSS 35072 KiB; excludes provider and real hardware; highly synthetic low resolution
controlled_results.before: 3 targeted tests failed because original decode did not support requested window; no tests weakened

limits: No semantic understanding, real video event recall, billed model token or actual provider call
Input duration and source identity are caller-supplied or container-declared, not independently authorized or semantically qualified
FFmpeg seek accuracy across arbitrary codecs, long GOPs, fragmented inputs, timebase wrap, VFR held frames and real sources require more controlled counterexamples
Partial windows or missing metadata never imply a whole video was observed
No original Memory/Kernel source dependency, platform account or withdrawal integration; A and NanaLink must own these
next: B validates long GOP, timestamps and multi-window resource behaviour; NanaLink supplies authorized source; A integrates original S5/Memory/Provider/withdrawal as appropriate
